readme.note: API call demo. ApiCaller shows how to fetch(...) with a secret from Local Settings (File > Load Local Settings) as a placeholder credential — replace the URL and secret key name with a real one. ApiReceiver just passes through whatever it gets; its badge automatically turns blue for one tick whenever the value it receives actually changes (this is a built-in engine behavior, not something ApiReceiver's script has to implement — see js/simulation.js's `changed` field). The endpoint here is a placeholder and won't really respond — swap it for your own API to see this run live.

parts.label: ApiCaller
parts.description: Placeholder API call using ctx.secrets — load a Local Settings file first (File > Load Local Settings) with an API_KEY entry. Replace the URL below with a real endpoint.

parts.label: ApiReceiver
parts.description: Passes through whatever ApiCaller sends. Its badge turns blue for a tick whenever the received value actually changes — automatic, not scripted here.
